verdict.rationale: The Agent SDK is fundamentally natural-language driven: queries are plain text prompts sent to Claude which interprets intent and invokes built-in/custom tools, subagents, and MCP integrations accordingly (docs-1, docs-2, docs-4, docs-5, docs-13). Streaming/interactive mode and AskUserQuestion clarifications reinforce conversational, NL-based operation (docs-12, docs-18, docs-19). missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence specifically confirming NL command interpretation quality; some community commentary criticizes the harness/DX rather than the NL interface itself.
